title: Huge AI models that only wake up a few experts
hook: Reflection AI announced Beam, an open model with 501 billion parameters in total but only 23 billion active at a time. It was trained on 23.8 trillion tokens, and the weights and technical report are due later this month.
explain: This design is called a sparse mixture of experts. The model is split into many small expert networks, and for each word only a few are used. That keeps the model big and knowledgeable while making each answer cheaper to compute.
